job.question: In the Los Angeles City Employees' Retirement System (LACERS) actuarial RFP, how many years of experience must the lead actuary have?
job.expected_facts: At least 15 years of experience with major public employee retirement systems, including at least 3 years with California public pension fund clients similar to LACERS.
job.acceptance: Accept 15 total and three California years. Do not require credential details unrelated to the years asked.

reviews.reason: The document is a Hawaii ERS private equity consultant RFP, not the LACERS actuarial RFP. Its experience requirements concern an offeror and a primary investment consultant, not a lead actuary; it does not support the required LACERS experience thresholds.
quotes: Employees’ Retirement System of the State of Hawaii Request for Proposals Private Equity Consultant Services RFP 2022-04 Issued AUGUST 29, 2022

The primary consultant assigned to the ERS account shall have a minimum of seven (7) years experience providing domestic and international private equity/debt consulting services to public pension plans.
